parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue but may introduce unexpected behavior.

issues.description: The patch calls `evalf` recursively on the result of `_imp_`, which could lead to infinite recursion if `_imp_` itself returns a function that calls `evalf`.
The patch does not include any tests to verify that the recursive call to `evalf` does not introduce new issues or regressions.
